headline: Codelco Records $4.8 Billion Impairment Charge and Third-Quarter Net Loss
summary: State-owned Chilean copper miner Codelco recorded impairment charges of about $4.8 billion on major mines, resulting in a net loss for the third quarter despite surging sales near record prices.
why: Large asset impairments at state-owned mining enterprises impact sovereign balance sheets and national resource revenue generation.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Substantial asset impairment charges at the state copper producer impact public sector financial returns.
